resources.title: AC/A Ratio Calculation and Clinical Management
resources.subject: Binocular Vision & Orthoptics
resources.description: Concise high-yield revision notes covering the gradient vs heterophoria method, clinical significance of high/low AC/A ratios in strabismus and non-strabismic binocular vision anomalies.
resources.author: Department of Binocular Vision

resources.title: Static Retinoscopy Fundamentals & Optical Principles
resources.subject: Refraction & Retinoscopy
resources.description: Comprehensive slide deck detailing speed, width, brilliance, and alignment of the retinoscopic reflex, working distance deduction, cylinder axis hunting, and scissors reflex neutralization.
resources.author: Clinical Optometry Faculty

resources.title: Retinoscopy & Subjective Refraction Viva Master Question Bank
resources.subject: Refraction & Retinoscopy
resources.description: Curated collection of 120+ viva-voce questions and model answers on streak retinoscopy, cycloplegic refraction, Jackson Cross Cylinder, and fogging techniques.
resources.author: Academic Board of Examiners

resources.title: Objective Refraction in Challenging Clinical Cases
resources.subject: Refraction & Retinoscopy
resources.description: Clinical seminar proceedings discussing retinoscopy in media opacities, high irregular astigmatism, keratoconus, pseudophakic eyes, and uncooperative pediatric patients.
resources.author: Senior Optometrist Clinical Forum

resources.title: Ocular Anatomy: Ciliary Body & Aqueous Dynamics
resources.subject: Ocular Anatomy & Physiology
resources.description: In-depth notes on ciliary body histology, pars plicata vs pars plana, blood-aqueous barrier, active ultrafiltration, uveoscleral outflow pathways, and clinical correlations in glaucoma.
resources.author: Dept. of Ocular Anatomy

resources.title: Geometrical Optics: Thick Lens Systems & Cardinal Points
resources.subject: Physical & Geometrical Optics
resources.description: Step-by-step mathematical derivations of equivalent power, back vertex power, front vertex power, principal planes, nodal points, and matrix optics for multi-lens systems.
resources.author: Optics Physics Division

resources.title: Soft Contact Lens Fitting Philosophy & Troubleshooting
resources.subject: Contact Lens
resources.description: Essential clinical handbook on base curve selection, diameter, Dk/t, silicone hydrogels, push-up test, movement, wettability, and resolving edge standoff or fluting.
resources.author: Contact Lens Clinic Faculty

resources.title: RGP Lens Fluorescein Pattern Interpretation
resources.subject: Contact Lens
resources.description: High-resolution photographic slide deck analyzing apical clearance, apical bearing, alignment fits, astigmatic patterns (WTR/ATR), and peripheral clearance dynamics under cobalt blue light.
resources.author: Specialty Cornea & CL Service

resources.title: Low Vision Assessment & Magnification Calculations
resources.subject: Low Vision Care & Rehabilitation
resources.description: Formulas and clinical workflows for relative distance magnification, relative size magnification, angular magnification, Kestenbaum's rule, and CCTV prescription for macular disease.
resources.author: Low Vision Rehabilitation Center

resources.title: Slit Lamp Biomicroscopy: Direct, Indirect & Sclerotic Scatter
resources.subject: Investigative Optometry & Imaging
resources.description: Mastery of slit lamp illumination techniques: diffuse, direct focal, specular reflection, retroillumination, sclerotic scatter, and tangential illumination with case examples.
resources.author: Diagnostic Optometry Unit

resources.title: Glaucoma Staging: Visual Fields (HFA) & OCT Interpretation
resources.subject: Glaucoma & Perimetry
resources.description: Comprehensive guide to Humphrey Visual Field (24-2, 30-2, 10-2 SITA Standard), mean deviation, pattern standard deviation, Glaucoma Hemifield Test (GHT), RNFL thickness, and GCC analysis.
resources.author: Glaucoma & Imaging Faculty

resources.title: Ocular Pharmacology: Mydriatics, Cycloplegics & Anti-Glaucoma Drugs
resources.subject: Ocular Pharmacology
resources.description: Core clinical reference textbook section covering mechanism of action, onset, duration, contraindications, and systemic absorption of Tropicamide, Cyclopentolate, Atropine, PGAs, and Beta-blockers.
resources.author: Clinical Pharmacology Board

resources.title: TNMGRMU Year 1 Comprehensive Question Bank (2018–2025)
resources.subject: General Anatomy & Physiology
resources.description: Full compilation of 7 years of university theory examination papers (Papers I, II, III, IV) categorized by 15-mark essays, 5-mark short notes, and 2-mark brief answers.
resources.author: Academic Resource Committee

resources.title: Dispensing Optics: Progressive Addition Lens (PAL) Fitting & Troubleshooting
resources.subject: Dispensing Optics
resources.description: Practical dispensing manual explaining corridor length, fitting cross placement, pantoscopic tilt, vertex distance, wrap angle, and fixing peripheral swim or narrow reading zones.
resources.author: Ophthalmic Dispensing Academy

resources.title: Paediatric Vision Assessment: Cardiff, Teller & Kay Pictures
resources.subject: Paediatric Optometry
resources.description: Seminar on quantitative visual acuity testing in pre-verbal children, preferential looking cards, Lea symbols, cycloplegic regimen, and amblyopia risk factor screening.
resources.author: Paediatric Eye Care Study Group

resources.title: Diabetic Retinopathy Classification & ETDRS Protocols
resources.subject: Posterior Segment & Systemic Diseases
resources.description: Clinical presentation illustrating microaneurysms, dot-blot hemorrhages, hard exudates, cotton wool spots, IRMA, venous beading, and clinically significant macular edema (CSME).
resources.author: Vitreoretinal & Medical Retina Unit

resources.title: Keratoconus Detection, Pentacam Corneal Tomography & Scleral Lenses
resources.subject: Contact Lens
resources.description: Grand rounds presentation covering Belin-Ambrosio enhanced ectasia display, pachymetry progression indices, CXL referral criteria, and PROSE/scleral landing zone optimization.
resources.author: Corneal Ectasia Study Consortium

resources.title: B.Optom 4th Year Clinical Internship Logbook & Protocols
resources.subject: Clinical Examination Protocols
resources.description: Standardized clinical case presentation format, mandatory clinical postings competencies, refraction verification log, and specialty rotation guidelines.
resources.author: Directorate of Clinical Education

resources.title: Ocular Pathology & Microbiology Laboratory Manual
resources.subject: General & Ocular Pathology
resources.description: Laboratory guide detailing Gram stain, Giemsa stain, KOH mount for fungal keratitis, Acanthamoeba culture, and conjunctival impression cytology for dry eye diagnosis.
resources.author: Dept. of Ocular Microbiology

resources.title: Public Health Optometry & Vision 2020 Guidelines
resources.subject: Public Health & Community Optometry
resources.description: Epidemiology of avoidable blindness in India (NPCBVI), RAAB surveys, school eye screening protocols, primary eye care infrastructure, and cataract surgical coverage metrics.
resources.author: Community Ophthalmology Unit

resources.title: Prisms in Optometry: Prentice Rule & Prism Adaptation
resources.subject: Optometric Optics
resources.description: Comprehensive notes on Prentice's rule (P = cF), differential prismatic effects in bifocals and anisometropia, slab-off grinding, Fresnel prisms, and prism adaptation test (PAT).
resources.author: Optometric Optics Division

resources.title: Biochemistry of the Crystalline Lens & Cataractogenesis
resources.subject: Biochemistry & Nutrition
resources.description: Detailed biochemical pathways of crystallin proteins (alpha, beta, gamma), sorbitol pathway in diabetic cataract, glutathione antioxidant mechanisms, and lipid peroxidation.
resources.author: Dept. of Biochemistry

resources.title: Strabismus Diagnostics: Hirschberg, Krimsky & Cover Tests
resources.subject: Binocular Vision & Orthoptics
resources.description: Step-by-step clinical evaluation of manifest vs latent strabismus, unilateral cover test, alternate cover test, prism bar cover test (PBCT) at distance and near, and kappa angle calculation.
resources.author: Orthoptics & Strabismus Clinic

resources.title: Occupational Eye Hazards & Industrial Visual Ergonomics
resources.subject: Occupational Optometry
resources.description: Chemical, mechanical, radiation, and digital eye strain hazards. ANSI Z87.1 safety eyewear standards, VDT workstation lighting design, and contrast sensitivity evaluation in workers.
resources.author: Occupational Vision Taskforce

resources.title: TNMGRMU Year 3 University Model Question Bank
resources.subject: Binocular Vision & Orthoptics
resources.description: Curated previous university questions for Binocular Vision, Contact Lens, Low Vision Aids, Glaucoma, and Dispensing Optics with answer hints and key diagram blueprints.
resources.author: Senior Academic Board
